text:
devon: heads-up — main just went red after the merge from #1234, job `integration/gpu-e2e` failing consistently :grimacing:
ci-bot: Pipeline 2027-07-12-03:45 triggered by merge commit abcdef1. Job integration/gpu-e2e FAILED (step: run-e2e-tests). Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/2027/1795432100
morgan: assigning to @zane since he owns the e2e suite last touched in that PR @zane? :eyes:
zane: on it, grabbing logs now. quick glance shows a bunch of crashes in `test_kv_cache_eviction` on CUDA nodes, stacktrace points at kv_cache.cpp:line 412
oncall-sre: I see increased GPU OOMs in the last hour across the gpu pool, might be related to a memory regression. Cluster events: node-gpu-5 had a driver restart at 03:40 UTC
priya: fyi the merged PR changed default cache size from 512MB -> 1GB (intended perf optimization). could explain mem pressure.
alex: can we do a focused rerun for the failing job on a single node to reproduce? rerun id: `rerun 1795432100 --job integration/gpu-e2e --node node-gpu-5`
ci-bot: Rerun started (id: 1795432178). Keeping artifacts and logs.
zane: repro started, running with extra logging. if it fails I'll run git-bisect locally across the last 5 merges
morgan: if it's the cache size change, we can try a hot rollback of that config in the runtime to validate quickly — easier than a full revert.
priya: agree. quick patch to set CACHE_DEFAULT=512MB in runtime config should be trivial. I can push a config-only patch to infra and trigger a canary.
oncall-sre: note that if we reduce cache size we might hit perf regressions for unrelated workloads. recommend canary in staging then prod. but given current red on main, a short config rollback in test clusters is fine to confirm root cause. :+1:
zane: failing test reproduces on rerun. dump attached: ```
Assertion failed: kv_cache eviction exceeded limit (used=1.02GB, limit=1.00GB)
Backtrace: ...
```
alex: ok that's a smoking gun — eviction logic hit the new default. can you try re-running with env override `KV_CACHE_LIMIT=512MB`? quick command: `bazel run //infra/ci:runner -- --job integration/gpu-e2e --env KV_CACHE_LIMIT=536870912`
ci-bot: Rerun started (id: 1795432255) with env override KV_CACHE_LIMIT=536870912
zane: rerun with override PASSED. all tests green on that run.
morgan: so change in PR that increased cache size without adjusting eviction thresholds caused OOMs leading to test failures. next step: either adjust eviction logic to tolerate larger defaults or revert the PR.
priya: I'll open a follow-up PR to make the eviction more robust (upper-bound safety check) and also propose a canary rollout for the config change. in the meantime I'll revert the default to 512MB in runtime config and trigger a guarded rollout.
devon: thanks team — can we also bisect to find if some infra change made eviction stricter? zane, you mentioned bisect earlier — is that still needed?
zane: not necessary for root cause now that we reproduced with the new default. but I'll run a quick bisect across the past two weeks to be safe. no blockers for reverting the config now.
oncall-sre: I'm monitoring the GPU pool. after the config revert I can run a smoke sweep to ensure no OOMs.
priya: revert pushed (config-revert-1795432340), triggering canary rollout to test cluster now.
ci-bot: Deploy to test-cluster started (deploy id: 1795432350). Health checks enabled.
alex: once canary looks good, let's coordinate a fast rollback on main or keep the revert behind a feature flag until the eviction fix lands.
devon: agreed — plan: 1) keep main with reverted config, 2) priya works on eviction fix, 3) we add a regression test that exercises cache boundaries in CI, 4) zane runs bisect for peace of mind. will follow up in thread. thanks everyone :tada:
ci-bot: Thread closed by devops-bot after successful canary on test-cluster.
